title: Thinking, Effort, Vision, and Structured Outputs

questions.prompt: How do you configure thinking on current Claude models?

options.text: Prefill the reply with "Let me think"
Thinking can't be used through the API

questions.explanation: Current models use adaptive thinking; the manual budget_tokens mode is rejected, and prefill returns a 400.

questions.prompt: Match each API setting to what it does.

pairs.right: Trades thoroughness against tokens and latency
Returns a readable summary of Claude's reasoning
Constrains the reply to a JSON schema
Links answer text back to source passages

questions.explanation: Effort sets how much work Claude does, display controls thinking visibility, format enforces a schema, and citations make document answers verifiable.

questions.prompt: Thinking blocks come back with empty text by default; set display to "____" to receive a readable summary.
questions.explanation: display defaults to omitted. Thinking still happens and is billed; summarized returns a readable summary.

questions.prompt: Which replace the old prefill tricks on current models? Select all that apply.

options.text: A system-prompt instruction to skip preambles
A tool with an enum field for classification labels
Prefilling the assistant turn with an opening brace

questions.explanation: Prefilling the final assistant turn returns a 400 on current models; use structured outputs, instructions, or enum tools instead.

questions.prompt: Order the steps to get validated, typed output in Python.

items.text: Use response.parsed_output as a validated object
Define a Pydantic model for the fields you need

questions.explanation: Define the schema as a Pydantic model, pass it to messages.parse, and read the validated parsed_output.

questions.prompt: Which combination returns an error when used in the same request?

options.text: Document citations together with structured outputs
An image block together with a text block
Adaptive thinking together with an effort setting
A system prompt together with messages

questions.explanation: Citations are incompatible with output_config.format; use a two-step pipeline if you need both.
